name: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Hash Encoding
aliases: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding
definition: A method using a multiresolution hash grid encoding to enable fast training (minutes) and interactive rendering (tens of fps) by skipping empty space and using fewer network queries.
summary: Instant-NGP drastically reduces NeRF training time to minutes and enables interactive rendering by replacing positional encoding with a multi-resolution hash grid for efficient feature lookup.
